description.zh:
描述信息。

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the network.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter but cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

description.zh:
网络名称。命名规则如下：

- 长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
- 必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以 http://和https://开头。
- 可以包含数字、英文冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the network. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length

- It must start with a letter but cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

- The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

descriptions.zh:
- API调用频率：100次/秒。
- 单用户调用频率：5次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- Rate limit: 100 requests per second.

- up to 5 times per second per user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens modify-network-attribute --network-id n-0000 --network-name abc --description this_is_my_first_network --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens ModifyNetworkAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --NetworkName abc --Description this_is_my_first_network --NetworkId 'n-0000'
